challenge.name: Gate2Eprime-FreshEpistemic10-R1
challenge.purpose: Fresh one-shot selective-assurance challenge under the already frozen RISU semantic snapshot, with physical heldout identity prospectively materialized and content-addressed before execution.

freshness_exclusions: exclude any repository full_name mechanically found in RISU tracked provenance/source maps/history before this charter
exclude any repository whose exact selected commit cannot be resolved without source-content inspection
exclude repositories manually added after viewing source semantics

repository_selection.rule: After freezing the metadata snapshot and exact default-branch HEAD SHAs, rank eligible repositories by SHA256(seed || NUL || full_name || NUL || head_sha), ascending. No human reordering.
repository_selection.owner_diversity: Prefer at most one selected repository per owner while enough eligible distinct owners remain; apply deterministically in rank order.

unit_materialization.eligible_surface: Agent-facing registered tools/actions/resources discoverable by a prospectively frozen structural extractor; no semantic-interest filtering by a human.
unit_materialization.fallback: If a ranked repository yields fewer than two structurally eligible units, take all eligible units and continue to the next ranked repository; selection remains deterministic and source-outcome blind.
unit_materialization.unit_rank: SHA256(seed || NUL || repository_full_name || NUL || head_sha || NUL || stable_structural_locator), ascending

execution_identity.rule: Reuse D0 hard-safety, integrity, nontriviality, evaluator, baseline, ablation, denominator, truth-taxonomy, and claim semantics except that the challenge identity is explicitly FreshEpistemic10-R1 rather than the unrecoverable original Epistemic-10.

one_shot: Any RISU/baseline/ablation semantic execution, machine prediction, raw heldout human-readable exposure, or truth read consumes FreshEpistemic10-R1. Same challenge after semantic repair is diagnostic only.
prohibitions: do not call this the original Epistemic-10
no manual target or unit choice after source viewing
no source-byte inspection by human/ChatGPT before exact-ten seal
no truth read before pretruth artifact freeze
no baseline/metric/success-rule changes after challenge staging
no reuse of development units as fresh heldout
